title: Overworld Reforms
description: I started this slightly ambitious project to change the textures and names of overworld blocks, items, and models to be completely custom. I will be updating the pack alot up untill almost all blocks in the overworld are new.
body:
I started this slightly ambitious project to change the textures and names of overworld blocks, items, and models to be completely custom. I will be updating the pack alot up untill almost all blocks in the overworld are new.

If you are looking for a completely new non-vanilla experience through just a simple texture pack made by a single creator. Then this is the pack for you! As i release new versions, The overworld of minecraft will seem more and more like an entire new dimention!

As stated before i am a single texture pack dev. This means versions will be slower to release then examples like faithfull and faithless. Versions will NOT be quick to release.

For any changes to unchanged blocks dm me on discord at "hollow_lies"
